descriptionlist.description: System-wide live weather for iOS 15-16+ rootless jailbreaks (Dopamine & Palera1n).
Animated live weather backgrounds on the Home Screen and Lock Screen using Apple's native WeatherUI .caml Mica animations and sky gradients.
Interactive modular Lock Screen weather components with drag-and-drop wiggle edit mode, greeting text, temperature, condition glyph, and native forecast platter.
Live updating Weather app icon, status bar weather glyph and temperature replacement, and default fallback city selection inside the Weather app.

changelog.change: Native WeatherUI .caml Mica animated weather backgrounds
Updated CoverSheet Lock Screen hooks, safe introspection, and CFPreferences IPC
